start.speaker: Kronos
start.text: Well, well... The hands of my clock have spun their last for these little games. And you... you stand victorious.

GCD2.speaker: Kronos
GCD2.text: Impressive. You have danced through the currents of time, untangled my messes, and proven your worth.

GCD3.speaker: Player
GCD3.text: I just wanted my yarn ball back. You certainly have a strange way of asking for help.

GCD4.speaker: Kronos
GCD4.text: Hah! A direct approach is so... linear. It's been eons since I've had such a delightful spectacle. Watching you outwit those old fools was marvelous fun.

GCD5.speaker: Kronos
GCD5.text: But a promise is a promise, even for one who stands outside of time. You have earned your reward.

GCD6.speaker: Kronos
GCD6.text: Here. Your precious ball of yarn, as agreed.

GCD7.speaker: Player
GCD7.text: Finally! After all that, I can just be a normal cat again.

GCD8.speaker: Kronos
GCD8.text: Ah, but has this adventure not changed the very thread of your existence? Thank you, little cat, for this grand diversion.

end.speaker: Kronos
end.text: Now... your own path awaits. Farewell.
